result.title: Investigating the efficacy of vortex beam speckle patterns for the recognition of atmospheric turbulence and fractional topological charge with a deep learning model
result.summary: Fractional topological charge (TC) enlarges the usable mode set of orbital angular momentum (OAM) links, but reading it reliably after atmospheric turbulence remains difficult. Interferometric and diffractive methods need an undistorted beam and a careful alignment, while most learned approaches treat integer or coarsely spaced charges and do not include turbulence. Here we ask whether the charge of a scalar vortex beam can be regressed directly from a single speckle image, and at which turbulence strength this stops working. We propagate vortex beams over 1500~m through 150 von Kármán phase screens, scatter them with a fixed random diffuser, and record $256\times256$, 16-bit speckle images for TC from 0 to 10 in steps of 0.01 and turbulence strengths $D/r_0$ from 0 to 50; the results reported here use a subset of 20\,000 images, and a data set of $10^{6}$ images is in preparation. A convolutional neural network estimates the TC and, through an auxiliary head, the turbulence category. On charges withheld from training, the mean absolute error is 0.031 without turbulence (with a common intensity scale) and rises to 0.78 at $D/r_0=10$ and 1.85 at $D/r_0=50$, against 2.5 for a constant prediction, and the turbulence category is identified correctly in 78\% of the images. The results show that, at the present training size, the charge is read accurately only without turbulence, and that the charge and the turbulence oth act on the speckle grain size, which may limit the readout. Experimental validation and the extension to vector vortex beams are left for future work.

AI.brief_summary: 该研究在 1500 m 传播、150 层 von Kármán 相位屏与固定随机散射体条件下生成 256×256 散斑图，用带辅助分类头的 CNN 从单张散斑图回归分数拓扑电荷（并识别湍流类别），并测出电荷读数误差随湍流强度增大而崩坏的边界。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“单张退化观测中能否读出连续潜在量、以及在何种退化强度下读出失效”的评测方式，可能启发 LVR 中视觉证据退化下的能力边界评估；论文指出电荷与湍流共同作用于散斑粒度、彼此纠缠而限制读数，可供核查 VLM 内部状态是否保留任务必要细节、能否解耦混淆因素，但领域相距较远。
